Today's businesses aren't analyzing data only internally; they're serving analytics and other business intelligence directly to their customers. That shift requires infrastructure to deliver on three areas: speed, scalability and efficiency. Historically, engineering teams had to choose two.

Traditional analytical databases were built for batch jobs and internal business intelligence. But as companies serve dashboards and real-time insights directly to customers, modern enterprises require systems that can handle petabyte-scale datasets and process complex queries in milliseconds instead of minutes — without ballooning infrastructure costs. 

[ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/) delivers on all three, which is why IVP is joining the company’s $350 million Series C.

##### ClickHouse: Better, faster, cheaper — no compromise necessary

ClickHouse shatters the conventional “pick two, sacrifice one” notion of the analytical database triangle:

**Data better**: ClickHouse adopts a columnar architecture for analytical workloads, thus scaling horizontally to handle massive data volumes.

**Data faster**: ClickHouse processes complex queries up to **100x faster** than traditional solutions.

**Data cheaper**: As an open-source solution with a cloud service offering, ClickHouse delivers dramatic cost efficiency: customers have seen a 3-5x reduction in costs compared to existing data platforms. And its flexible pricing model supports this, giving teams better control over their costs and utilization planning.

Better, cheaper, faster unlocks new industries and products that were impossible without ClickHouse: Instacart services real-time analytics directly to retail and advertising partners; Coinbase refreshes cryptocurrency valuations every few minutes; Flock Safety gives police departments and property managers up-to-the-minute video footage. 

##### A leadership team built to solve enterprise data needs

ClickHouse’s leaders form a unique triangle, too — of complementary technical and business skills and experience that make them difficult to compete against. 

Co-founder and CEO [Aaron Katz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aaron-katz-5762094/) brings deep go-to-market expertise from his leadership roles at Elastic and Salesforce, orienting him toward customer needs and organizational buying patterns. 

President [Yury Izrailevsky](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yuryizrailevsky/) brings decades of distributed systems experience from Google and Netflix, where he helped scale some of the largest platforms in the world.

CTO [Alexey Milovidov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexey-milovidov-7b658135/) created ClickHouse inside Yandex to solve demanding internal analytics challenges – and continues to guide its architectural evolution. 

Together, Aaron, Yury and Alexey form one of the most technically rigorous and mission-driven teams in modern data infrastructure, with more than 2,000 paying cloud customers across fintech, security, media and developer tools sectors.

##### Making ClickHouse customers very happy, very fast

What sets ClickHouse apart isn't just the "speeds and feeds" of technical specifications. In our conversations with customers, we heard a consistent theme: ClickHouse makes their teams look like heroes.

One customer put it this way: "The response time is in milliseconds, which makes our customers very happy." That kind of speed doesn’t just show up in benchmarks. It drives better product experiences, tighter feedback loops and the kind of loyalty that technical advantages alone cannot secure.

AI will push current analytical databases to their limits and ClickHouse offers a clear path forward — one where performance, scalability and cost-efficiency no longer require compromise. We’re proud to partner with a team that understands that the ClickHouse product is about supercharging business outcomes and delighting customers.

I moved to San Francisco, sight unseen, after reading the Facebook S-1. My freshman class was one of the first to use Facebook, and I could hardly believe the scale and impact of the business Facebook had seemingly built overnight. After living in London, New York, Singapore and Sydney, I was fascinated to discover what made Silicon Valley the world’s best environment for empowering entrepreneurs.

After almost a decade in San Francisco, I was inspired to bring the Valley mentality to my native UK, and to the rest of Europe. We set up IVP London to accelerate European entrepreneurs’ global ambitions.

I’ve been lucky to work closely with category-defining founders at companies like Discord, Hims & Hers, and UiPath. These experiences guided my personal approach to working with entrepreneurs: Listen hard, challenge when necessary, and be authentic, no matter what.

Today, I lead sales as CRO at ClickHouse, helping the team accelerate adoption, scale the organization, and build lasting customer relationships. I continue to support IVP as a Venture Partner, working closely with founders on go-to-market strategy and executive hiring. What drew me to IVP was not just the people—Ajay, Somesh, and Jules, whom I’ve known for over a decade—but also the partnership structure. We operate as a team, without a “single name on the door,” ensuring that every company we work with has access to the collective expertise, support, and commitment needed to scale their company.

I love working with entrepreneurs who are disruptive, determined, and focused—those with a bold vision and a sharp eye for the details. The most successful leaders understand that they alone are not scalable, that they require greatness around them to realize their goals. I’m at my best when helping hire talent for near-term needs and future demands or optimizing the intersection between product-led growth and high-touch sales. I’m passionate about helping entrepreneurs navigate it all, empowering them to make decisions that shape the future of their companies and their industries for the better.
